decisions.why: Sensus SRT-100 (superficial radiotherapy system), Cablon Medical CNERGY Go! and C-Rad Catalyst+ HD PT (surface-guided radiotherapy positioning) are radiotherapy treatment/positioning equipment, matching Mobile & RT simulation

Sun Nuclear SunCHECK (radiotherapy/imaging QA software) and Phantom Laboratory Catphan phantoms (CT/imaging QA phantoms) are quality-assurance and calibration tools for imaging equipment, matching Service & managed equipment
